entry.summary:
Source: @RezaEjtehadi

"For Sharif" This note has been written by a group of faculty members of Sharif University of Technology. We write this text not as lawyers, not as student advocates, and not from a position of defending a particular political or social behavior; rather, it is a letter of grievance from a group of faculty members of Sharif University of Technology; those who have lived in this university for years, trained students, and have considered "Sharif" not merely a collection of buildings and regulations, but a scientific and human family. You can read the full text of the note and the complete list of signatories in Telegra.ph. The list of signatories is being updated. 🆔 @Sharif_senfi
